scope: Static CPU diagnostic only. No simulator, actuator changes, or production goals from object truth.
attachment_assumption: The entire mustard mesh is hypothetically rigidly attached at the recorded closure-relative pose; this run did NOT prove a secure grasp.

bounded_command_contract_proposal.status: planning recommendation only; not implemented or validated dynamically
bounded_command_contract_proposal.command_bounds: intersection of previous command +/- rate*dt, measured q +/- axis tether, and unchanged real hard joint limits; empty intersection stops without a jump
bounded_command_contract_proposal.trajectory: one monotone shared interpolation parameter per joint-space segment; may pause for tracking, never jump to the next waypoint from command arrival alone
bounded_command_contract_proposal.stage_deadline: nominal max-axis travel/.10 plus finite measured-settle allowance; retains real joint progress checks and hard posture budgets
bounded_command_contract_proposal.filter_behavior: zero at a new measured waypoint reference; freeze both command and correction history during public-motion pauses
bounded_command_contract_proposal.effort_configuration: original stiffness80/damping4/100Nm effort limit unchanged; the tether limits reference error, not physical torque capacity
bounded_command_contract_proposal.grasp_prerequisite: real independent payload-following evidence before high raise or navigation; a width window alone is insufficient

limitations: joint limits and static payload clearance only; no contact, balance, motion tracking or secure-grasp certificate
fixed body pose from one completed local seed; live production must use public measured q and bounded paths, never these GT coordinates
torque upper includes arm gravity and any 0.5 kg COM within the full source mesh; excludes acceleration, transient contact and unknown friction
non-arm collision envelope uses current measured leg geometry; leg motion and chassis rocking need added clearance
